items.title: Ray Lopez Interview, 1958-08-30
items.q: Charlie Mac, he buzzed Smiley and so Smiley sends Joe to go and contact these guys... Joe called me. He got a hold of us and he, he, he, he fell up a deal for us. And from there on we went.

ctx.x: Um, I haven't lived there that long, but anyway, I remember some old books and pictures after it called that. Yeah, yeah. I remember seeing a lot of pictures.

Theodore Grumwald was the manager, see, the owner, rather. And, uh, so this Wyntle Howard, this beautiful review she had on it. And she was a beautiful dancer. So her manager, might have been her husband, I don't know, he come to me one day. He said he got a, when Sworn Mac went back to Chicago, they put the buzz on to Smiley Carbett. Smiley's going around crazy looking for a band. He had a little gypsy outfit. Uh, Drigo, the gypsy violinist, used to dance around there and smile at the women. You know, the guy,…
